$comment: Declared app↔package schema divergences (#1769). Each entry says WHY a consumer copy differs from packages/*/schemas. Undeclared behavioural drift fails CI. Regenerate with: node scripts/check-schema-drift.mjs --update — it preserves these reasons.

apps/velo/schemas/pages.json.reason: Stale copy, inert — predates the `admin`/`scoped` visibility options. Harmless today because the option list the UI renders is hardcoded in crouton-pages' Workspace/Editor.vue, not read from this file. kassa's identical case was reconciled in #1769; velo and the pocs below are the same one-line fix, left out of that issue's scope.

fixtures/with-sales/schemas/printers.jso.reason: Stale copy — the fixture still requires `locationId`, which the package dropped when receipt printers stopped needing a location. Reconciling it means regenerating the fixture, so it is declared here rather than half-fixed (#1769).

fixtures/with-sales/schemas/products.jso.reason: Stale copy of the exact #1769 defect — the fixture lacks the `required: true` that kassa gained in this issue. Same reconcile, but it needs a fixture regeneration to stay coherent with the generated table, so it is declared rather than half-fixed.

pocs/booking-demo/schemas/location.json.reason: Intentional — `offerFullDay` (#2261) is an optional per-location switch, off by default; the demo has no full-day use and no column for it. Package code reads it as `undefined` → off. Add it here (plus a migration) only if the demo needs full days.

pocs/crouton-builder/schemas/pages.json.reason: Not the CMS pages collection — the builder POC reuses the `pages` name for its own canvas model (`board`, `isHome`; no content/layout/SEO/visibility). It shares only a basename with crouton-pages, which is what pairs them here.

pocs/kvr/schemas/settings.json.reason: Intentional — kvr is a work-permit app, not a booking app: it drops the package's `groups`/`statuses` repeaters and adds its own `recipients` email list.

pocs/sintlukas/schemas/categories.json.reason: Not really the same collection — sintlukas reuses the `categories` NAME for CMS categories (colour, thumbnail, background, sidebar flag) rather than crouton-sales' event-scoped POS categories. The basename collision is what pairs them here.

pocs/sintlukas/schemas/locations.json.reason: Not really the same collection — sintlukas' `locations` are school campuses with addresses and coordinates, not crouton-sales' event-scoped prep stations (hence also no `requiresHandover`). Basename collision, as with categories.json above.
